targets.title: Gender differences in political knowledge: Bringing situation back in.
targets.evidence_quote: I have used the original dataset and script file that authors provided to OSF. I have uploaded both of them to my OSF and they are also available in the study’s OSF website.
targets.outcome_computational_quote:
Reproduction outcome: Based on these criteria, the claim did not reproduce.
Discussion: In contrast with the others, this claim was not reproduced using the script provided by the authors. The authors did not provide the syntax for this analysis. They have done the analysis manually.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Because authors manually calculated the results; not enough detail was provided in the paper for me to do the same analysis manually. As a result, I decided to conduct these two analyses using my own script.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Three claims reproduce precisely, while the two reconstructed analyses disagree. For 4knqr8 the obtained t=1.41, d=.26 and p=.081 disagree with t=1.90, d=.36 and p=.03 and fail even the approximate reproduction criteria. The analyst treats this as non-reproduction. The reconstructed scripts seek the original calculations; no substantive alternative specifications or sensitivity analyses are evaluated.
